other_candidates.disposition: Do not force first iteration; power and signal resource risk. 6S/6G/4P is a separately constrained alternative.
Fallback only after measured escape/channel shortage or need for added ground separation; PDN failure may need a different budget.
Fallback only after measured need; not the existing 32-layer arbitrary-blind mixed-plane structure.

manufacturing.concept: Two buildup layers each face plus a manufacturer-defined core; 24-layer concept 2+20+2, 20-layer concept 2+16+2.
manufacturing.microvia_policy: Only near-surface adjacent layer transitions proposed; staggered preferred. Stack/fill, core span, backdrill and all dimensions require fabricator approval.

before_claiming_24_routable: Authenticate endpoint pinout and footprints, or label the result explicitly as placeholder-only geometry
Define manufacturer-legal via primitives and actual stackup; no invented thickness or Dk
Complete required connectivity and verify every mandatory pad, no power-domain merges
Demonstrate actual escape and local corridor capacity for all planned data/control routes
Validate GND projection, return stitching, S-S coupling, impedance, loss, timing and PDN/thermal targets
try_20_only_after: 24-layer actual routing and PDN/return-path constraints pass with quantified local margin
Reroute independently for eight internal signal layers and six GND layers; no deletion/remapping shortcut
escalate_28_or_32_if: Verified legal-via escape or local channel capacity fails after geometry/route optimization
Adjacent S-S coupling requires more ground separation and the reduced-signal 24-layer alternative lacks capacity
Verified CPU/PEX/SSD power delivery needs additional copper resources
do_not_infer: No empty old layer means 32 is necessary
Low global area percentage means 24 will route
A local route failure means the whole candidate is impossible
Native DRC zero means SI/PI/fabrication signoff
